runtime.previewMechanism: Army screen age-preview controls; this reviews roster art for each age without changing or claiming natural campaign progression.
commonFindings: Each preview rendered its own age-specific muster-yard art without the previous square blank Kingdom construction plots.
The two current formation cards, three preview recruitment cards, Army inspector, combat stats and Barracks lock explanation stayed legible at the reviewed viewport.
The preview uses current Stone formations alongside the selected age's recruitment roster; this is a visual candidate check, not a natural journey through all eight ages.

Mock 24 shows a medieval garrison yard and standing troops; the live product retains operational formation cards, recruitment cards and a separate details inspector. Layout fidelity, character geometry at dense sizes and owner acceptance remain open.

ages.runtimeFinding: Natural prehistoric hide-and-timber perimeter, palisade and hillside around a broad open muster yard; current formation, recruit and inspector controls remain readable.
Mudbrick, timber and reed structures frame a broad packed-earth yard; old blank construction patches are absent in the roster preview.
Hillfort and palisade frame an open yard with no visible Kingdom plot grid; differentiation from Stone and Bronze still needs age-family semantic review.
Stone curtain wall, gate and timber courtyard provide the closest scene match to mock 24; open ground keeps roster content visible.
Early-modern brick fort and bastion details frame an uncluttered muster yard; cards and inspector remain readable.
Brick industrial works, a water tower and fenced storage establish the period around an open troop yard; Industrial recruitment labels remain readable.
Modern depot, hangar, storage, fencing and communications mast establish the period; contemporary troop cards and details remain readable.
Advanced city base and broad paved muster apron frame Future recruitment; the previously prominent square floor seams are no longer visible at 1280 by 720.

notClaimed: Natural campaign progression or roster testing at every age
All required viewport and dense-layout checks
Scene-character placement and full mock fidelity
Final desktop, packaged, device or release acceptance
